ground_design.low_storefront_stone_edges_role: visual_floor_contact; not independent solid/ghost or generated-building cast
ground_design.native_flagstones: continuous octagonal chipped polygons, real open variable joints, .055 proportional bevel with .94 edge-tone factor
ground_design.outer_shoulder_transition: continuous native-local boundary band 1..6m, no per-stone missing blocks or checker mask

ground_design.roughness: main-axis polish separated from outer rough flags; independently licensed rock ARM/normal microdetail only
ground_design.source_texture_role: original builtin-generated worn limestone ALBEDO; NOT CC0 or scanned PBR

height_grid.collision_support: actual dry ArrayMesh and independent body polygons; no water floor white paint or atlas shadows
height_grid.height_domain: Flat constructed dry platform Y0, separate negative canal bottom with vertical masonry quay; RF values sampled from same explicit domains, not a natural slope interpolation across the wall
